description:
The 4StoreyBuilding commercial office model is open in eQUEST. A retro-commissioning audit requires updates to the Ground Floor HVAC systems to improve energy efficiency and meet ventilation codes. 

1. Locate the five Ground Floor packaged single-zone systems (G.S01, G.E02, G.N03, G.W04, G.C05) in the Air-Side HVAC module.
2. For EACH of these five systems, change the Night Cycling Fan Control (NIGHT-CYCLE-CTRL) to 'Cycle on Any' (CYCLE-ON-ANY). This enables the fan to cycle on during unoccupied hours if any zone gets too hot or cold.
3. For EACH of these five systems, update the Minimum Outside Air flow (MIN-OUTSIDE-AIR) to 200 CFM to meet ASHRAE 62.1 standards.

After making these 10 changes (2 parameters x 5 systems), run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation and save the project.
